personality_profile.leadership_style: Product-led: defines the vision, recruits exceptional people, creates space for fast execution, moves ahead of consensus.
personality_profile.decision_making_pattern: Fast and intuitive, informed by strong pattern recognition from Big Tech product culture. Occasionally moves ahead of stakeholder alignment.
personality_profile.stress_response: Channelled into building — under pressure he accelerates rather than consolidates. This can be brilliant or destabilising depending on context.
personality_profile.collaboration_style: Highly collaborative within his team, less so with external stakeholders from traditional automotive backgrounds. Has been coached on this.

hr_assessment.promotion_trajectory: Ready now for the right mandate — specifically founding-executive or transformation leadership. Wrong for operational stability roles. At risk of departure if not given meaningful scope expansion.
hr_assessment.key_strength_observed: Rarest internal profile: genuinely bilingual between software-native and automotive culture. Revenue growth and team-building track record is extraordinary for his age.
hr_assessment.development_area: Board-level political navigation and patience with institutional pace. Tendency to dismiss traditional automotive colleagues creates cross-functional friction that will limit him at the most senior levels.
hr_assessment.raw_opinion: Transformative in connected services — €410M revenue, 140-person team built. Rare bilingual software/automotive capability. Was passed over for Group CTO which I disagreed with. Has had conversations with Rivian and a startup. Not leaving tomorrow but at risk. Occasionally dismissive of traditional automotive colleagues. Board-level stakeholder management still developing.

tension_summary: The most digitally capable leader in the internal pool with a genuine team-building track record — but his brilliance is optimised for building new things at speed, and any scenario requiring him to maintain trust with institutional stakeholders who move slowly will test whether his coaching on patience has actually landed.
